title: 02 Keystrata: enterprise mega footer
strengths: The status console is a real idea: 90 days of uptime bars with a hover tooltip ('Sep 12 · API latency · 14 min'), '99.998% uptime', and four region latencies in mono
Six columns on a strict grid with numbered mono labels (01 PLATFORM ... 06 TRUST), hairline dividers, small tags where they inform ('14 open', 'v4.12')
'Found a vulnerability? security@keystrata.com PGP 4F2A 9C1E 77B0' and 'Do not sell my data' are the details a security buyer looks for
slop_signals: A hero-style headline with a bold phrase ('from commit to runtime.') and two buttons at the top of a footer; the hero template repeated at the bottom
Six certification chips with check marks in a row (SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS 4.0): a badge row, even if a real one
Numbered column labels ('01 PLATFORM') are a 'we are precise' affectation rather than a wayfinding aid
fixes: Replace the headline-and-buttons band with the wordmark, one line and one text link; the status console is the footer's pitch
Set the certifications as one mono line ('SOC 2 Type II · ISO 27001 · ...') linking to the trust center, or as small seals like Vanta's, not check-mark chips
Drop the 01-06 numbering; the labels work without it

references.what: Six-plus columns on a strict grid, 'ALL SYSTEMS NORMAL' as a mono line, 'NEW' tags on links; the density without boxes we follow
Dense columns, region and language at the bottom, no headline or buttons in the footer
Compliance shown as three round seals, not six chips; 'HIRING' tag on Careers
Status line in mono with compliance marks and two 'featured' cards; a calmer top band
'System status: Operational' as a plain line plus SOC 2 and GDPR marks; the minimum version of our console
